sequential_dependency.intermediate: The transformed tight crop (stage1), whose top-left cell is an input-dependent second command.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Apply the outer command at input (0,0) to the tight crop of nonzero content.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Read stage1[0][0] and apply that command to stage1.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step A moves a source corner into stage1[0][0]; changing or skipping A changes which command Step B reads and therefore changes the final output.
